data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Experience menu, then Baggage allowance, then the cabin class, with cabin_class as the parameter), and the only differences are an added "open site" step and "read the table", which are harmless; it is slightly less concrete about how the cabin class is selected (tab vs. link), but a browser automation could still be built from it.
